Hi friendie 😊 I’ve just picked a cool thing and been totally hooked! 🧑🏼🎨👀

I got this sweet pottery-making course at our local rec, & man it is fun & super meditating, I think! You've known for ages I've got an arts bug & have always been into crafts and creating things by my hand...so thought why delay this? 

We do simple stuff first but it is all about building & sculpture with the mud - so tactile in the hand. And it feels so satisfying when a bowl starts to emerge. Then it is glazed, bisquet and fired & comes home. So I've got my little mug set to make as my first project & will be customising the glaze.

So far just loved learning all that is behind how things get shaped - it’s like engineering with clay - you need just a touch here and push a pinch here... And all my friends will see the results in our upcoming summer picnic - they’re gonna
